messages:
mike: quick heads-up, onboarding helix-8b (hf -> redwood int4) on staging. fp16 looks fine but int4 shows token shadowing on compound tokens and weird repeat patterns after ~1024 tokens.
anya: numbers? small bench?
mike: summarization rouge-l fp16 39.8 -> int4 22.4. longctx recall@1 fp16 86% -> int4 58%. sample shows token id swaps for composed tokens (e.g., `data-driven` -> `data - driven`).
zhou: ugh. could be rotary scaling mismatch + tokenizer normalization. helix checkpoints have an older `rotary_scale` array (per-head) and a custom pretokenizer that preserves zero-width joiners. converter might have dropped both.
kevin: also check head layout: helix uses two-head interleave in some layers (even_odd). converters usually assume contiguous. mix of layout + per-head scale problems will scramble logits for compound tokens.
mike: repro command I ran:
```
python tools/convert_model.py --src=hf --dst=redwood --model=helix-8b --quant=int4 --proj_layout=auto
```
mike: quick eval log:
```
[eval] rouge-l: 22.4 (fp16 39.8)
[longctx_recall@1] 0.58 vs 0.86 fp16
```
anya: try forcing proj_layout=even_odd and load per-head rotary_scale from checkpoint if present. also run a small scan for tokenizer normalization differences (ZWNJ / ZWJ).
zhou: helper loop to scan candidates:
```
for layout in ["contiguous","interleaved","even_odd"]:
  for alpha_mode in ["use_checkpoint","default"]:
    python tools/mini_probe.py --model helix.ckpt --proj_layout $layout --rotary_mode $alpha_mode --suite summarization --max_pos 2048
```
kevin: I ran that locally: layout=even_odd + rotary_mode=use_checkpoint recovers rouge-l to 38.9. tokenizer normalization still causes minor diffs though.
mike: confirmed: even_odd + checkpoint rotary_scale -> rouge-l 38.7; then applying token normalizer that maps ZWJ/ZWNJ to preserved forms recovers longctx recall to 84.5.
anya: good. open ticket and add metadata keys to artifact: "proj_layout", "rotary_scale_source" (checkpoint|default), "tokenizer_normalizer" (preserve|fold), and a `tokenizer_hash`. Console should surface mismatch warnings.
zhou: also add a small autodetect in convert pipeline: test layout candidates and rotary modes on a 20-sample microbench and pick best ppl/rouge; if ambiguous, emit a warning and keep auto=false. include head_mapping in metadata when we apply a permutation.
kevin: CI note: any int4 conversion should run the 6-benchmark overnight and fail onboarding if rouge/recall delta > 5% vs fp16.
onboard-bot: created RED-1159: "helix-8b int4 proj_layout + rotary_scale + tokenizer-normalizer" assigned to mike.
mike: will open PR with autodetect + metadata + small regression tests. target: patch by EOD and full eval run tonight. dropping sample prompts and mini-probe logs in the ticket.
anya: add a short doc blurb about how tokenizer normalization affects KV-cache offsets so support teams recognize client/runtime mismatches.
zhou: one more: ensure KV-cache index mapping updates when we permute heads, and include a migration note for any pinned clients.
mike: noted. will attach mapping and upgrade checklist in the PR. ping when ready for review.
